summary: This bill amends federal law to create specific penalties for individuals who willfully cause serious bodily injury to a person because of their status as a law enforcement officer, or attempt to do so, with enhanced penalties if death, kidnapping, or attempted killing occurs.

scores.thoughts: This bill creates a new federal crime for willfully causing serious bodily injury to a law enforcement officer because of their status, or attempting to do so, with severe penalties including life imprisonment if death results. It explicitly aims to punish offenses targeting law enforcement, which aligns with stricter justice and stronger policing.
